---
title: "References"
---

Key literature supporting EVD management, transport safety, and clinical practice. Click a category to expand it.

```{ojs}
references = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  // Live listener — updates automatically whenever References
  // changes in Firestore (this also re-fetches PubMed metadata for
  // any newly added reference, since referencesWithMeta depends on
  // this cell's value).
  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(collection(db, "References"), snapshot => {
      notify(snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data()));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Firestore only stores pmid/type/color — fetch title/authors/journal
// live from PubMed's own API (NCBI E-utilities), batched into one request.
referencesWithMeta = {
  const pmids = references.map(r => r.pmid).filter(Boolean);
  if (pmids.length === 0) return references;

  try {
    const url = `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=${pmids.join(",")}&retmode=json`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    const data = await res.json();

    return references.map(r => {
      const s = data.result?.[r.pmid];
      if (!s) return r;
      return {
        ...r,
        title: s.title,
        authors: (s.authors || []).map(a => a.name).join(", "),
        journal: s.fulljournalname,
        pubdate: s.pubdate
      };
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return references;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
groupedReferences = {
  const groups = new Map();
  referencesWithMeta.forEach(r => {
    const key = r.type ?? "Uncategorized";
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(r);
  });
  return [...groups.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
}
```

```{ojs}
// Deterministic color per category name — same category always
// gets the same color, no manual mapping to maintain.
function categoryColor(name) {
  const palette = ["#007AFF", "#34C759", "#FF9500", "#AF52DE", "#FF3B30", "#30B0C7", "#FF2D55", "#8E8E93"];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  return palette[Math.abs(hash) % palette.length];
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<div>
  ${groupedReferences.map(([type, refs]) => {
    const color = categoryColor(type);
    return `
      <details class="fs-accordion">
        <summary class="fs-accordion-summary" style="background:${color};">
          <span class="fs-accordion-name">${type}</span>
          <span class="fs-accordion-count">${refs.length}</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="fs-accordion-body">
          ${refs.map(r => `
            <div class="fs-ref-entry">
              <p class="fs-ref-title">${r.title ?? `PMID: ${r.pmid}`}</p>
              ${r.authors ? `<p class="fs-ref-authors">${r.authors}</p>` : ""}
              ${r.journal ? `<p class="fs-ref-journal">${r.journal}${r.pubdate ? ` (${r.pubdate})` : ""}</p>` : ""}
              <a class="fs-ref-link" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/${r.pmid}/" target="_blank">View on PubMed →</a>
            </div>
          `).join("")}
        </div>
      </details>
    `;
  }).join("")}
</div>`
```

::: {.callout-note}
Titles, authors, and journal names are fetched live from PubMed using each reference's PMID.
:::
